covers: The registers of the YM3526 (OPL1) FM synthesizer. Every number from 0x00 to 0xFF is stored on a write, so a number not named here, or an unused offset inside a range, is kept and has no effect.

left_out.why: the OPL2's waveform select does not exist on the OPL1: the write is stored, and every operator keeps its one waveform because the waveform enable reads 0 on this revision

entries.name: test
entries.description: Test register, stored by the chip.
entries.behaviour: Stored and unused by MAME. Bit 5 does not enable waveform selection here, because the OPL1 has a single waveform and its waveform enable is fixed at 0.

entries.name: timer 1 value
entries.description: Timer 1 preset: the 8-bit value timer 1 loads when it starts.
entries.behaviour: Holds timer 1's 8-bit preset, which MAME multiplies by 4. It is read when timer 1 starts or restarts after an overflow, so a change while the timer runs waits for the next restart. Bit 0 of register 0x04 starts it.

entries.name: timer 2 value
entries.description: Timer 2 preset: the 8-bit value timer 2 loads when it starts.
entries.behaviour: Holds timer 2's 8-bit preset, read when the timer starts or restarts after an overflow. One step of timer 2 lasts four times one step of timer 1. Bit 1 of register 0x04 starts it.

entries.name: timer control
entries.description: Timer control: starts and masks the two timers and resets their flags.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 set clears both timer flags and the interrupt, and the other bits of that write are ignored. Otherwise bits 0 and 1 start timer 1 and 2 (clear stops it), and bits 6 and 5 mask the flag of timer 1 and 2: it reads 0, raises no interrupt, and the write clears it.

entries.name: CSM, note select
entries.description: Mode register: CSM mode and the note select bit.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 selects CSM mode: each timer 1 overflow keys on all nine channels. Bit 6 is note select: it picks the F-number bit that gives the low bit of the key-scale code, the top bit when clear and the next one down when set.

entries.name: rhythm and depth
entries.description: Rhythm register: the tremolo and vibrato depths, the rhythm mode and its five drum key-on bits.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 selects the deep tremolo, bit 6 the deep vibrato and bit 5 rhythm mode, which turns the last three channels into the drums. Bits 4 to 0 key on the bass drum, snare, tom, top cymbal and high hat, and act only while bit 5 is set: with it clear all five are keyed off.

entries.name: F-number low
entries.description: Frequency number, low byte: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Holds the low 8 bits of the channel's frequency number; bits 1 and 0 of the matching 0xB0 register are the high bits. Each address in the range is one channel's register.

entries.name: key on, block
entries.description: Key on, octave and the frequency number's high bits: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Bit 5 keys the channel on (clear keys it off), bits 4 to 2 give the block (octave) and bits 1 and 0 the high bits of the frequency number. Each address in the range is one channel's register.

entries.name: feedback, connection
entries.description: Channel feedback and connection: one register per channel.
entries.behaviour: Bits 3 to 1 give the feedback of the first operator and bit 0 the connection: clear feeds the first operator into the second, set adds the two. Bits 7 to 4, the output selects of later OPLs, are ignored. Each address in the range is one channel's register.

sources.cites: uint32_t ch_feedback(uint32_t choffs) const      { return byte(0xc0, 1, 3, choffs); }

entries.name: operator mode
entries.description: Operator mode: tremolo, vibrato, envelope type, key scaling and the frequency multiplier, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 enables tremolo, bit 6 vibrato, bit 5 holds sustain until key off, bit 4 is key scale rate, bits 3 to 0 the multiple. One register per operator, at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21; a channel uses o and o+3, o = channel mod 3 + 8 * (channel div 3).

entries.name: operator level
entries.description: Operator level: key scale level and total level, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 and 6 give the key scale level, bit 7 being its low bit, and bits 5 to 0 the total level. One register per operator, at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21; other offsets are unused.

entries.name: attack, decay
entries.description: Operator envelope: attack rate and decay rate, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 to 4 give the attack rate and bits 3 to 0 the decay rate. One register per operator, at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21; other offsets are unused.

entries.name: sustain, release
entries.description: Operator envelope: sustain level and release rate, one register per operator.
entries.behaviour: Bits 7 to 4 give the sustain level and bits 3 to 0 the release rate. One register per operator, at offsets 0 to 5, 8 to 13 and 16 to 21; other offsets are unused.
